title: Exactness of scalar sections on an affine open
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and $W$ an affine open of $X$. Let $S=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. The sequence of sections on $W$, restricted to $k$ along the structure map, is short exact. The functor is the actual scalarFunctor followed by sheafToPresheaf and evaluation at $W$, not a choice of vector spaces.

proof.text: Forget the short exact module-sheaf sequence to abelian sheaves using preservation of finite limits and colimits.

Apply the proved source cechAcyclicOnAffines_of_isQuasicoherent to the kernel and surjective_app_of_cechAcyclicOnAffines on W. The latter uses finite standard refinements and affine Cech acyclicity to lift quotient sections.

SheafOfModules.evaluation preserves kernels and monomorphisms. Combine this with the obtained surjectivity to obtain ShortExact, then map through exact ModuleCat.restrictScalars. The evaluation/change-of-rings composite is definitionally picardScalarSectionsFunctor.

theorem picardScalar_affine_sections_exact
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (S.map (picardScalarSectionsFunctor f W)).ShortExact
